input.quote: 11.1.1.4 Trial Data Package. SFJ shall be the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein.
input.rationale: Ownership of pre-existing PB IP (11.1.1.1) and of Trial Inventions (11.1.1.3, with SFJ assignment) is favourable to us and untouched. The failure is Section 11.1.1.4: SFJ is sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package, which by definition (1.1.193) covers all Information generated in the Clinical Trials by or on behalf of a Party — including the clinical data we and our CROs/Sites generate — and PB only obtains ownership by paying the Approval Payments plus a further redacted sum. No interim licence or use right is reserved to PB anywhere; the Research Results confidentiality deeming (p0062) confers no use rights. That fails both the preferred position and the fallback. Because SFJ's ownership underpins the development-funding and termination payment structure (Sections 6.1, 14.2–14.3), we take the fallback: SFJ owns its generic tools and know-how, and PB receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence, sublicensable, to use and modify the Trial Data Package and Research Results for its business, surviving termination.

ops.text: SFJ shall own its generic tools and know-how used in performing its obligations hereunder, and SFJ hereby grants to PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license, with the right to sublicense, to use and modify the Trial Data Package and all Research Results for its business, and such license shall survive any expiration or termination of this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept SFJ holding the Trial Data Package and Research Results with no rights reserved to us pending the purchase, so we have added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back (with sublicensing) to use and modify that data for our business, while confirming SFJ owns its generic tools and know-how.
proposal.summary: Add SFJ generic tools/know-how ownership and a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to PB of the Trial Data Package and Research Results
